title: 第857章 落天生被擒双方交易第856章 苏婉儿消息离开黑魔族
content_zh:
三个月之后，两人终于到了边界。
之所以延长了一个月，是路上时不时遇到魔修，为了不惊动人，张扬将速度放得很慢。
尽管小心翼翼，两人最后还是被几名巡查元婴修士发现。
张扬没有选择恋战，带着雷秋雪突围，没料到最后还是被人给堵上了。
大魔界边界，防守如同铁桶一般，在外面极难见到的元婴修士，在这里数见不鲜。
“道友，咱们不是正道联盟的人，只是路过，还请放行。”
张扬目光扫过周围六名元婴修士，冷冷地说道。
四名元婴初期，两名元婴中期，这些战力，都不够他塞牙缝。
“你说不是就不是？”为首魔修冷哼一声，“识相的束手就擒，乖乖跟我们去大本营，查明身份之后，如果不是正道联盟的人，可以放行。”
“道友不信的话，可以联系贵族大统领——大统领应该不是你们能联系的，你就联系郭槐，或者严永歌也行。”张扬淡淡地说道。
“你算什么东西，也配见左将跟军师。”
旁边一名元婴初期修士怒道。
雷秋雪身影在原地一闪，倏忽之间，已经落到那修士头顶，一剑劈出。
那修士并未将这普通一剑看在眼里，施展神通相迎。
摧枯拉朽，剑芒瞬间便破了神通，当头斩落。
那修士大惊，连布几道防御，可早已无力回天。
剑芒瞬间破掉所有防御，将那修士劈成两半，连元婴都没逃掉。
周围的元婴修士脸色大变，纷纷后退，距离比起之前远了几倍。
“需要我再说一遍吗？”张扬淡淡地问。
为首的元婴修士脸色大变，赶紧用水镜沟通严永歌。

严永歌听闻之后，赶紧让他们放行，不得阻拦。
为首元婴修士眼神复杂地看着两人，赶紧放行。
张扬继续赶路，没多久，一道乌光从天而降，化为一名身材婀娜的女子。紧身装将她的身体勾勒得浑圆饱满，又英气逼人，又女人味飞扬。
“大统领邀请两位过去一聚，不知道两位赏不赏脸？”严永歌开门见山。
“咱们还有急事，就不过去了。”张扬回道。
“耽搁不了两位多少时间。”
“咱们一刻也不想耽搁。”
去别人的地盘，相当于将小命交给别人掌握，张扬才不会这么傻。
两人绕了老大的弯子，避过了魔族大军的中心区域，就是为了避开魔族的精锐。
“张道友能否将大统领的半截黑链交还，大统领说他欠你一个人情，以后定会报。”她终于说出来意。
张扬内心冷笑，回道：“实不相瞒，那魔链在下已经毁掉了。”
严永歌一怔：“毁掉了？”
content_en:
Three months later, the two finally reached the border.
The reason why it was extended for a month was that he encountered demonic cultivators from time to time on the road. In order not to alarm people, Zhang Yang slowed down.
Despite their caution, the two were eventually discovered by several patrolling Nascent Soul monks.
Zhang Yang did not choose to fight, and led Lei Qiuxue to break out. Unexpectedly, he was blocked in the end.
The border of the Great Demon Realm is defended like an iron barrel. Nascent Soul monks, who are extremely rare to see outside, are not uncommon here.
"Fellow Taoist, we are not from the Righteous Alliance. We are just passing by. Please let us go."
Zhang Yang glanced at the six Nascent Soul cultivators around him and said coldly.
Four early-stage Nascent Souls and two middle-stage Nascent Souls. These combat strengths were not enough for him to fill his teeth.
"You say it's not true?" the leader of the demonic cultivators snorted coldly, "If you are wise enough to surrender, follow us to the base camp. After we find out your identity, if you are not a member of the Righteous Alliance, you can let him go."
"If fellow Taoists don't believe it, you can contact the noble commander--the commander-in-chief is probably not someone you can contact. You can contact Guo Huai or Yan Yongge." Zhang Yang said lightly.
"Who do you think you are? You're worthy of seeing General Zuo and his military advisor."
A monk in the early stage of Nascent Soul next to him said angrily.
Lei Qiuxue's figure flashed on the spot. Suddenly, she had landed on top of the monk's head and struck out with her sword.
The monk didn't take this ordinary sword seriously and used his magical power to greet it.
Destroying the dead, the sword light broke through the magical power in an instant, and chopped off the head.
The monk was shocked and even deployed several defenses, but he was already helpless.
The sword light instantly broke through all defenses and split the monk in half. Not even the Nascent Soul could escape.
The expressions of the surrounding Nascent Soul cultivators changed greatly, and they all retreated. The distance was several times further than before.
"Do you need me to say it again?" Zhang Yang asked calmly.
The leader's Nascent Soul cultivator's face changed drastically, and he quickly used a water mirror to communicate with Yan Yongge.
After Yan Yongge heard about it, he quickly let them go without stopping them.
The leader, the Yuanying monk, looked at the two of them with complicated eyes and quickly let them go.
Zhang Yang continued on his way, and not long after, a black light fell from the sky and transformed into a graceful woman. The tight-fitting outfit outlines her body, which is round and plump, making her look heroic and feminine.
"The commander-in-chief invited you two to come over for a get-together. I wonder if you would appreciate it?" Yan Yongge got straight to the point.
"We still have urgent matters, so we won't go over there." Zhang Yang replied.
"It won't take you two long."
"We don't want to waste a moment."
Going to someone else's territory is equivalent to leaving your life in someone else's hands. Zhang Yang wouldn't be so stupid.
The two of them took the boss's detour and avoided the central area of ​​the demon army, just to avoid the elite of the demon clan.
"Can you Daoyou Zhang return half of the black chain of the commander-in-chief? The commander-in-chief said that he owes you a favor and he will repay it in the future." She finally expressed her intention.
Zhang Yang sneered inwardly and replied: "To be honest, the magic chain has been destroyed."
Yan Yongge was startled: "Destroyed?"
